reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Iowa
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: In an eviction (action for possession), can a tenant rebut/raise the defense
    that the landlord refused a voucher?

    This program encodes ONLY the provided Iowa Code sections (562A.15, .21, .24, .26, .27, .36)
    and the scenario facts, then derives yes/no.
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic helpers (no external modules)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% True when N is <= M (integers assumed for simplicity).
lteq(N, M) :- integer(N), integer(M), N =< M.

% True when N is >= M.
gteq(N, M) :- integer(N), integer(M), N >= M.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Metadata
state(iowa).
focus_year(2021).

% Parties
tenant(t1).
landlord(l1).

% Action (eviction action = action for possession)
eviction_action(a1).
action_kind(a1, possession).

% The question does not specify the eviction ground; to be maximally charitable to
% a tenant defense regime in Ch. 562A, we encode it as nonpayment-based.
action_basis(a1, nonpayment_of_rent).

% Tenant is in possession at time of action (relevant to 562A.24(1))
tenant_in_possession(a1, yes).

% Voucher-related facts in the question
tenant_has_voucher(t1, housing_choice_voucher).
landlord_refused_voucher(l1, t1, housing_choice_voucher).

% The tenant attempts to raise "voucher refusal" as a defense in the eviction action.
tenant_raises_defense(a1, voucher_refusal).

% Facts NOT present in the question (encoded explicitly as absent by omission):
% - no habitability/code noncompliance facts under 562A.15
% - no required written notices under 562A.21 or 562A.27(4)
% - no retaliatory conduct predicate facts under 562A.36
% - no unlawful ouster facts under 562A.26
% - no rental-agreement term requiring acceptance of voucher

% Helper predicate required by prompt: succeeds when scenario facts are satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    state(iowa),
    focus_year(2021),
    tenant(t1),
    landlord(l1),
    eviction_action(a1),
    action_kind(a1, possession),
    tenant_has_voucher(t1, housing_choice_voucher),
    landlord_refused_voucher(l1, t1, housing_choice_voucher),
    tenant_raises_defense(a1, voucher_refusal).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (deterministic predicates)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
    IA Code  562A.15 (2021) - Landlord to maintain fit premises.
    We model the existence of a landlord duty and a possible breach.
*/

% 562A.15(1)(a)(1)-(6) - enumerated duties (modeled as atoms).
ia562a15_duty(comply_building_codes_material_health_safety).
ia562a15_duty(make_repairs_keep_fit_habitable).
ia562a15_duty(keep_common_areas_clean_safe).
ia562a15_duty(maintain_facilities_good_safe_working).
ia562a15_duty(provide_receptacles_and_removal).
ia562a15_duty(supply_running_water_hot_water_heat).

% A landlord is noncompliant with 562A.15 if there is a fact of breach of one of these duties.
% (In this scenario, no such facts are asserted, so this will fail.)
ia562a15_noncompliance(Landlord) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    ia562a15_duty(Duty),
    landlord_breached_ia562a15_duty(Landlord, Duty).

/*
    IA Code  562A.21 (2021) - Tenant remedies for landlord noncompliance (general).
    Not directly a defense to possession by its text, but it defines a "noncompliance"
    concept tied to 562A.15 or rental agreement, with notice requirements.
*/

% 562A.21(1) - a tenant may terminate after written notice and 7-day cure period.
% We encode the notice requirement as a predicate (not satisfied in scenario unless facts exist).
ia562a21_notice_requirements_satisfied(Tenant, Landlord) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant_delivered_written_notice_562a21(Tenant, Landlord, DaysBeforeTermination),
    gteq(DaysBeforeTermination, 7),
    landlord_failed_to_remedy_within_days(Landlord, 7).

% 562A.21 - Landlord noncompliance concept: material noncompliance with rental agreement
% or noncompliance with 562A.15 materially affecting health and safety.
ia562a21_landlord_noncompliance(Landlord) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    (   landlord_materially_breached_rental_agreement(Landlord)
    ;   ia562a15_noncompliance(Landlord)
    ).

/*
    IA Code  562A.24 (2021) - Landlord's noncompliance as defense to action for possession or rent.
    562A.24(1): In an action for possession based upon nonpayment of rent (or action for rent where
    tenant is in possession), tenant may counterclaim for amount recoverable under rental agreement
    or chapter. If, after setoff, rent does not remain due, judgment shall be entered for tenant.
*/

% 562A.24(1) - predicate: action qualifies for 562A.24 counterclaim mechanism.
ia562a24_action_qualifies(Action) :-
    eviction_action(Action),
    action_kind(Action, possession),
    action_basis(Action, nonpayment_of_rent).

% 562A.24(1) - tenant may counterclaim for amount recoverable under rental agreement or chapter.
% We treat "recoverable under ... chapter" as meaning some recognized statutory monetary claim.
ia562a24_tenant_may_counterclaim(Action, Tenant, Amount) :-
    ia562a24_action_qualifies(Action),
    tenant_in_possession(Action, yes),
    tenant(Tenant),
    integer(Amount),
    Amount >= 0,
    tenant_counterclaim_amount_recoverable_under_chapter_or_agreement(Action, Tenant, Amount).

% 562A.24(1) - If rent does not remain due after application, judgment for tenant in possession action.
ia562a24_judgment_for_tenant_if_rent_not_due(Action, Tenant) :-
    ia562a24_action_qualifies(Action),
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord_claimed_unpaid_rent(Action, RentClaimed),
    ia562a24_tenant_may_counterclaim(Action, Tenant, CounterAmt),
    Net is RentClaimed - CounterAmt,
    lteq(Net, 0).

/*
    IA Code  562A.26 (2021) - Tenant's remedies for landlord's unlawful ouster/exclusion/diminution of service.
    Creates remedies if landlord unlawfully removes/excludes or willfully diminishes essential services.
    Not a defense-to-possession provision by its text, so we encode remedies only.
*/

ia562a26_unlawful_ouster_or_diminution(Landlord, Tenant) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    (   landlord_unlawfully_removed_or_excluded(Landlord, Tenant)
    ;   landlord_willfully_diminished_essential_service(Landlord, Tenant)
    ).

/*
    IA Code  562A.27 (2021) - Noncompliance with rental agreement-failure to pay rent-violation of federal regulation.
    562A.27(4): In action for possession based on nonpayment, proof of (a)-(d) is a defense.
*/

% 562A.27(4) - action must be possession based upon nonpayment of rent.
ia562a27_4_action_qualifies(Action) :-
    eviction_action(Action),
    action_kind(Action, possession),
    action_basis(Action, nonpayment_of_rent).

% 562A.27(4) defense elements (a)-(d).
% (a) landlord failed to comply with rental agreement or 562A.15
ia562a27_4_element_a_landlord_noncompliance(Landlord) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    (   landlord_materially_breached_rental_agreement(Landlord)
    ;   ia562a15_noncompliance(Landlord)
    ).

% (b) tenant notified landlord at least 7 days prior to due date of intent to correct at landlord expense
ia562a27_4_element_b_notice(Tenant, Landlord) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant_notified_landlord_intent_to_correct_at_landlord_expense(Tenant, Landlord, DaysPriorToDueDate),
    gteq(DaysPriorToDueDate, 7).

% (c) reasonable cost <= one month's periodic rent
ia562a27_4_element_c_cost_limit(Action, Cost) :-
    ia562a27_4_action_qualifies(Action),
    integer(Cost),
    Cost >= 0,
    one_month_periodic_rent(Action, OneMonthRent),
    lteq(Cost, OneMonthRent).

% (d) tenant in good faith corrected before receipt of written notice of termination for nonpayment
ia562a27_4_element_d_corrected_before_termination_notice(Tenant, Landlord) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant_corrected_condition_in_good_faith_before_termination_notice(Tenant, Landlord).

% 562A.27(4) - full defense
ia562a27_4_defense_to_possession(Action, Tenant, Landlord) :-
    ia562a27_4_action_qualifies(Action),
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    ia562a27_4_element_a_landlord_noncompliance(Landlord),
    ia562a27_4_element_b_notice(Tenant, Landlord),
    tenant_reasonable_cost_of_correction(Action, Tenant, Cost),
    ia562a27_4_element_c_cost_limit(Action, Cost),
    ia562a27_4_element_d_corrected_before_termination_notice(Tenant, Landlord).

/*
    IA Code  562A.36 (2021) - Retaliatory conduct prohibited.
    562A.36(2): If landlord retaliates (including by bringing/threatening action for possession after
    certain protected tenant conduct), tenant "has a defense in action ... for possession."
*/

% 562A.36(1) protected activities
ia562a36_protected_activity(complained_to_government_agency_health_safety_code).
ia562a36_protected_activity(complained_to_landlord_about_562a15_violation).
ia562a36_protected_activity(organized_or_joined_tenants_union).

% 562A.36(1) retaliatory acts
ia562a36_retaliatory_act(increasing_rent).
ia562a36_retaliatory_act(decreasing_services).
ia562a36_retaliatory_act(bringing_action_for_possession).
ia562a36_retaliatory_act(threatening_action_for_possession).

% 562A.36(2) - defense exists if landlord acts in violation of 562A.36(1).
ia562a36_defense_to_possession(Action, Tenant, Landlord) :-
    eviction_action(Action),
    action_kind(Action, possession),
    tenant(Tenant),
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant_did_protected_activity_within_one_year(Tenant, Activity),
    ia562a36_protected_activity(Activity),
    landlord_did_retaliatory_act(Landlord, Tenant, bringing_action_for_possession).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning: is "voucher refusal" a defense in the provided statutes?
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Recognized defenses to an action for possession, as encoded from the provided statutes:
% - 562A.36(2) retaliation defense
% - 562A.27(4) repair-and-deduct style defense (nonpayment actions)
% - 562A.24(1) setoff/counterclaim leading to no rent due (nonpayment actions)
%
% This is a closed-world list for this program (limited to provided statutes).

recognized_defense_type(retaliation_562a36).
recognized_defense_type(repair_deduct_562a27_4).
recognized_defense_type(counterclaim_setoff_562a24).

% Map a tenant-asserted defense label to one of the recognized defense types (if any).
% Crucially, "voucher_refusal" is NOT mapped unless it can be characterized as one of these
% statutory defenses based on facts (e.g., a rental agreement term or 562A.15 breach).
tenant_defense_characterization(voucher_refusal, retaliation_562a36) :-
    fail.
tenant_defense_characterization(voucher_refusal, repair_deduct_562a27_4) :-
    fail.
tenant_defense_characterization(voucher_refusal, counterclaim_setoff_562a24) :-
    % Voucher refusal could only matter under 562A.24 if it created a recoverable counterclaim
    % "under the rental agreement or this chapter". We require an explicit legal basis fact.
    fail.

% Decide if a tenant has a statutory defense to possession for a given asserted defense label.
tenant_defense_succeeds(Action, Tenant, Landlord, DefenseLabel) :-
    tenant_raises_defense(Action, DefenseLabel),
    tenant_defense_characterization(DefenseLabel, retaliation_562a36),
    ia562a36_defense_to_possession(Action, Tenant, Landlord),
    !.
tenant_defense_succeeds(Action, Tenant, Landlord, DefenseLabel) :-
    tenant_raises_defense(Action, DefenseLabel),
    tenant_defense_characterization(DefenseLabel, repair_deduct_562a27_4),
    ia562a27_4_defense_to_possession(Action, Tenant, Landlord),
    !.
tenant_defense_succeeds(Action, Tenant, _Landlord, DefenseLabel) :-
    tenant_raises_defense(Action, DefenseLabel),
    tenant_defense_characterization(DefenseLabel, counterclaim_setoff_562a24),
    ia562a24_judgment_for_tenant_if_rent_not_due(Action, Tenant),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer predicate
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    % In the scenario, the tenant is t1 and landlord is l1 and action is a1.
    tenant_defense_succeeds(a1, t1, l1, voucher_refusal),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that the landlord refused a voucher?
